set.nav.tutorial: Settings sidebar and page title for the feature ledger and tutorial replay.
set.nav.guide: Settings sidebar and page title for the per-widget user guide.
set.tutorial.replay: Button in Settings > Tutorial that opens the isolated practice demo from the beginning.
set.tutorial.replay_hint: Short explanation beside the replay button. It must say that practice data is not saved.
set.tutorial.level: Heading for one tutorial ledger level. {n} is the level number 1, 2 or 3.
set.tutorial.seen: Accessible status appended to a tutorial entry the user has already encountered.
set.tutorial.whats_new: Heading for the current version's newly introduced tutorial entries.
set.guide.try: Button on a widget Guide entry that opens an isolated demo focused on that widget type.
set.backup.open_folder: Settings > Backup and data: button that opens the WidgetBoard data folder in File Explorer. Replaces the old tray item.
set.about.report: Button in Settings > About. Opens an anonymous Google Form in the browser to report a bug. 1 to 3 words.
